decisions.point: Where to put home + article rendering
decisions.chosen: New subdirs api/src/public/templates/ + api/src/public/view-models/; existing router.ts wires them
alternatives: Rename router.ts to public-router.ts (rejected: noisy diff)
Inline templates as string constants in router.ts (rejected: 2000+ line file, untestable)
decisions.rationale: Keeps git diff focused on additive work; spec PART 5 explicitly names templates/ + view-models/ subdirs; rename touches every import site for zero behavioral gain.

decisions.chosen: Export CSS/JS as TypeScript string modules; serve via dedicated /assets/public.css + /assets/public.js Worker GETs with immutable Cache-Control
alternatives: Inline <style>/<script> in templates/layout.ts (rejected: not cacheable, inflates response size)
Raw .css/.js files imported via build-time text loader (rejected: no bundler text-loader configured in this Worker)
decisions.rationale: PART 13 requires public JS to be cacheable; exporting from .ts avoids toolchain changes.

decisions.chosen: Adapter reads articles.content_json first; falls back to a synthesized html block wrapping content_html when content_json is null/empty
alternatives: Only render content_html (rejected: design relies on typed blocks pullquote/figure/callout that cannot be derived from raw HTML)
Require migration to backfill content_json (rejected: out of scope; PART 0 forbids migrations)
decisions.rationale: Preserves design fidelity for typed-block articles while not breaking legacy raw-HTML articles.

decisions.chosen: Render <input>+<button> with visually-hidden label; POST to /api/newsletter/subscribe placeholder returning 501; disabled state driven by site.newsletter_settings_json.provider
alternatives: Hide newsletter entirely when no provider (rejected: PART 1 requires section 11 newsletter)
Real Mailchimp/Buttondown integration (rejected: explicitly out of scope)
decisions.rationale: Preserves required 13-section structure with accessible disabled state until Session 5+ wires a real provider.

decisions.chosen: Every view-model helper takes siteId as required positional argument; every D1 query WHERE site_id=?; tests exercise 2 sites with disjoint fixtures
alternatives: Encode siteId in Hono context global (rejected: implicit context harder to test)
Per-tenant D1 binding (rejected: re-litigates Phase 3 multi-site schema)
decisions.rationale: Explicit positional argument forces every caller (and test) to pass siteId; eliminates the R4 cross-site leak class.

decisions.point: Fallback strategy for template render failure
decisions.chosen: try/catch around renderArticle; on throw, fall back to legacy c.html(content_html ?? '')
alternatives: Let exception bubble to a 500 (rejected: silent regression for existing RSS-reader consumers)
Render an error page (rejected: changes contract for external embeds)
decisions.rationale: Preserves the existing /article/:slug contract during the template rollout; logs warning for observability.

implementation_steps: Phase B step 1: Create api/src/public/assets/public-css.ts (T1) + public-js.ts (T2) string modules.
Phase B step 2: Create api/src/public/templates/{layout,icons,format,seo,components}.ts (T3, T5, T7, T6, T4).
Phase B step 4: Create api/src/public/templates/{home,article}.ts wiring components + view-models + seo (T10, T11).

Phase B step 5: Update api/src/public/router.ts — add GET / (T12), update /article/:slug with template+fallback (T13), add /assets/public.css + /assets/public.js (T14), upgrade /category/:slug + /page/:slug to layout-wrapped (T15).
Phase B step 6: Add api/test/ regression suites T16-T22.
Phase B step 7: Run cd api && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test && npm run verify:no-legacy-prod-refs && npm run verify:infra && npm run verify:worker-config (T22).
risk_controls: R1: try/catch around renderArticle with fallback to legacy content_html; explicit T13.AC4 test.
R3: T18 regression test renders Home + Article for non-TheIWise tenant and asserts brand-leak absence.
R4: Every view-model helper requires siteId as positional non-optional argument; T8.AC4 exercises 2-site isolation.
R5: Promise.all parallel D1 queries; per-query try/catch; Session 6 KV-cache target documented.
R6: T3.AC1 + T20 assert skip-to-content + aria-label + img alt/width/height presence.
rollback_plan: Roll back per-file via `git checkout HEAD -- <path>` for each file in files_expected_to_change. The session is additive only — no migrations, no schema mutation. Reverting router.ts restores the legacy `c.html(content_html ?? '')` path for /article/:slug and removes the GET / + /assets/* + layout-wrapped /category|/page handlers. No data unwinding required.
evidence_plan: T8/T9 view-model unit tests: deterministic_grep_count for query shape + behavioral assertion via mock D1 stub.
T10/T11 template tests: behavioral via direct call + JSDOM/string parse; deterministic_grep_count for class-name presence.
T12-T15 router tests: behavioral via Hono app.request() + Content-Type/status assertions.
T16-T21 regression tests: behavioral assertions on rendered HTML for brand-leak, JSON-LD, image attrs, ad-slot attrs, reserved paths.
T22: test_exit_code on the 4 npm scripts.
call_path_expectation: GET / -> publicSiteContextMiddleware -> router.ts GET / handler -> buildHomeViewModel(db, siteContext) -> renderHome(vm) -> renderLayout wraps -> c.html(html). GET /article/:slug -> middleware -> handler -> try{ buildArticleViewModel(db, siteContext, slug) -> renderArticle(vm) -> renderLayout -> c.html(html) } catch { c.html(row.content_html ?? '') }. GET /assets/public.css -> handler -> import PUBLIC_CSS string -> c.body with Content-Type:text/css + Cache-Control immutable.
